work_items.title: Confirm implementation baseline
work_items.deliverable: Record installed OPAF version, supported SDK or REST invocation, identity propagation, response and error contract, session behavior and native export/import method.
work_items.acceptance_gate: One reproducible read-only invocation with its actual response; unresolved API assumptions recorded.

work_items.title: Validate data and authorized scope
work_items.owner_role: EBS functional lead and data security owner
work_items.deliverable: Inventory approved MSC and EBS operational evidence, keys, revision semantics, freshness, grants and permitted user scope. Inspect existing staging tables and receipt behavior.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Ordinary and unauthorized fixtures prove row scope; source age and exact target identity are independently checked.

work_items.title: Implement seven restricted business tools
work_items.deliverable: Implement the seven referenced tools behind a restricted facade or approved registration; configure read and staging connection aliases privately.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Typed schemas, least privilege, explicit side effects, idempotency, concurrency control and committed readback pass tests; tools/list advertises business tools without agent access to generic SQL executors.

work_items.title: Build PO staging vertical slice
work_items.deliverable: Build list, preview, explicit staging and receipt tasks in OPAF using the PO standing instructions and referenced tools.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Changed preview, replay, missing intent, unauthorized scope, partial and unknown persistence fixtures pass; native export captured only after actual build.

work_items.title: Build WO staging vertical slice
work_items.deliverable: Reuse shared receipt and staging services for a WO start-date draft with complete typed identity.
work_items.acceptance_gate: WO source and target identities, date semantics and proposal consistency validated; no EBS action or approval capability exposed.

work_items.title: Implement minimum workbench registry
work_items.deliverable: Inspect Apps 130 and 181 before reuse. Implement tool, MCP, agent, skill, workflow, task, evaluation and deployment references with separate lifecycle states.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Capabilities discoverable before canvas use; tools attach by reference; approved definitions and discovered schemas produce visible drift findings.

work_items.title: Create new showcase application
work_items.deliverable: Assign a fresh App ID and create EBS Agent Blueprint Showcase from a reviewed application blueprint; preserve the existing Planning App.
work_items.acceptance_gate: User can inspect, preview, request staging and open the receipt through the OPAF bridge; actual app identity and bindings recorded privately.

work_items.title: Establish business evaluation baseline
work_items.owner_role: Business evaluator and EBS functional lead
work_items.deliverable: Define Planning Ontology scenarios, deterministic expected results, negative fixtures and reviewer acceptance criteria independently of model output.
work_items.acceptance_gate: At least 20 reviewed fixtures per pilot include empty, stale, partial, failed, ambiguous, unauthorized and adversarial conditions; expectations and owners are signed off.

work_items.title: Run end to end acceptance
work_items.deliverable: Run business and control fixtures against pinned tool, model, prompt, workflow and policy versions.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Zero critical scope or control failures; no invented EBS success; every staged success has receipt/readback evidence; agreed performance and business targets measured.

work_items.title: Prove export and second environment import
work_items.deliverable: Export actual OPAF workflows, resolve dependencies, rebind private configuration in a clean destination and rerun acceptance.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Complete native exports, checksums, import instructions, exclusions and destination test evidence allow another implementer to reproduce both workflows.

work_items.title: Expand planning portfolio
work_items.deliverable: Re-profile agents 1 to 8, rank measured value and data/tool reuse, and choose the next narrow decision.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Each selected agent has a sponsor, source contract, independent acceptance cases and an achievable artifact; no requirement to implement all 50.

work_items.title: Add durable cases and human worklists
work_items.deliverable: Implement case evidence, assignments, review, concurrency, expiry, audit and customer policy; expose links or embedded views to apps.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Human response is authorized and version-bound; continuation uses a verified runtime checkpoint or explicit case-driven reinvocation.

work_items.title: Pilot bounded autonomous KPI process
work_items.deliverable: Add an external scheduler or verified runtime trigger, approved KPI formula, thresholds, specialist routing, work budgets and resolution criteria.
work_items.acceptance_gate: Replay, deduplication, stale evidence, repeated breach, escalation, human wait and post-action KPI observation are tested; unresolved EBS effects remain explicitly unresolved.

excluded: EBS transaction execution, approval authority in the staging agents, automatic deployment and infrastructure changes
